title: CWP/14830/2025 of OM PARKASH BABBAL Vs UNION OF INDIA AND OTHERS
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL
text:
120 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH CWP No.14830 of 2025 (O&M) Date of Decision: 06.08.2025 OM PARKASH @ BABBAL .....Petitioner Versus UNION OF INDIA AND OTHERS ........Respondents CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK MANCHANDA Present: Mr. Ritesh Tomar, Advocate, for the petitioner. ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL, J. (Oral) The petitioner has challenged the letter/order dated 26.03.2025 (Annexure P-8) issued by respondent No.2, whereby he was asked to remove the unauthorized occupation.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is owner of the land as per the revenue record and the construction of a cow shed and a hut had been regularized by respondent No.3 on 15.07.2001. The copy of said letter is at Annexure P-7. He further submits that without acquiring his land, the respondents cannot direct him to remove the construction which had been duly approved. Furthermore, on 29.03.2025 the petitioner had responded to the impugned order/letter dated 26.03.2025 but his reply has not been considered till date. He, therefore, prays that this petition be disposed of with a direction to respondent No.2 to consider the reply of the petitioner and decide the matter in a time bound manner.

3. Issue notice to the respondents. CWP No.14830 of 2025 (O&M) --2--

4. Mr. Raghujeet Singh Madan, Advocate and Mr. D.K. Prajapati, Advocate, accept notice on behalf of respondent No.2 and Mr. Anant Kataria, DAG, Haryana, accepts notice on behalf of respondents No.3 and 4.

5. Heard.

6. In view of the limited prayer, this petition is disposed of with direction to respondent No.2 to consider the reply of the petitioner and take a decision in the matter in accordance with law within a period of of two months from now. The petitioner would also be afforded an opportunity of hearing on 12.08.2025. (ANUPINDER SINGH GREWAL) JUDGE (DEEPAK MANCHANDA) JUDGE 06.08.2025 sandeep
